integrity_notes: Analytic proof for all matrices in scope; exact finite tests are supplementary. Novelty remains subject to independent historical-priority evaluation, including a plausible 2025 reference whose full text was inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Only complex Hermitian positive-definite 2-by-2 matrices and \(0\le t\le1\). The higher-dimensional conjecture and Löwner-order questions are not settled.
title: Dimension-two phase law for near spectral geometric log-majorization
